scope: Fetch/pickup and busy-duplicant scheduler compatibility evidence for CycleTrim. FetchPickupCandidatePatch remains disabled under FastTrack and now also yields conservatively when Efficient Supply is present; busy-duplicant patches remain behind the existing coarse FastTrack guard.

fetchCandidate.cycleTrimPolicy: CycleTrim does not install its UpdatePickups replacement when either FastTrack or Efficient Supply is present. This conservative type-presence rule avoids competing boolean Prefix replacements and intentionally gives up the optimization even when Efficient Supply is configured with a zero threshold.

efficientSupply.behavior: When enabled, Efficient Supply replaces UpdatePickups and ranks a pickup that satisfies the outstanding request amount threshold ahead of a closer pickup that does not. Competing CycleTrim path-cost-first replacement would bypass that behavior depending on prefix order.

busyDuplicantPickupSensor.behavior: FastTrack returns false from a low-priority prefix, replacing PickupableSensor.Update when PickupOpts is active. CycleTrim also targets PickupableSensor.Update as one part of BusyDuplicantChoreThrottlePatch.

busyDuplicantScheduler.behavior: With PickupOpts active, FastTrack replaces BrainScheduler.RenderEveryTick and routes brain groups through PriorityBrainScheduler.UpdateBrainGroup, which consumes priorityBrains according to ChorePriorityMode. Delay mode additionally gates Brain.UpdateChores on PickupOpts + FastReachability + ChorePriorityMode=Delay. This is an indirect scheduler/chore-pipeline interaction with CycleTrim's FindNextChore throttle and PrioritizeBrain invalidation hook, not a same-target patch conflict.

observedContract.cycleTrimCurrentPolicy: Keep busy-duplicant patches behind the existing FastTrack type-presence guard. Keep FetchPickupCandidatePatch behind both the existing FastTrack guard and the Efficient Supply marker. This source contract proves the competing replacement shapes; real ONI runtime evidence remains required before merging the activation change.
